concept: Kensington Runestone-inspired fictional Ground creature; Viking-inspired carved face and original rune grooves.

sources.evidence: Museum holds the Kensington Runestone, discovered near Kensington in1898; physical artifact and local discovery story inspire the design.
Describes the inscribed graywacke slab and the long-running authenticity controversy.
sources.boundary: Monster is original fiction. Do not present the artifact as evidence of medieval Viking settlement in Minnesota.
